info.title: Checkmarx One — local mock API
info.description: Synthetic responses only; no security analysis. This locally authored specification describes the implemented WireMock fixtures, not the complete official Checkmarx API. Use project mock-project and branch main, one scan at a time. First execute the Authentication token request with the prefilled dummy credentials. Copy access_token, click Authorize, and paste the token (without Bearer). Then create a project and scan; poll twice to reach Completed. Mock control lets you reset scenarios or inspect requests.

value.access_token: <copy the token returned by executing this request>
